_authoring.chronologyBoundary: Prefectural research attests the named Yamana retainer guarding Tottori before the1563 conflict, not a verified birth year. Initial Tottori location is a scenario approximation; no new clan or lord assignment.

off.takeda-takanobu.note: 鳥取縣文獻研究具名山名重臣、鳥取城守備及1563衝突；鳥取市大義寺頁記1578遇害傳承，縣研究未定精確卒年。不將此人物合併甲斐武田族人或加血親旗標。1529生年、四維、職階與1560城配置為設計，1578卒年是有來源但未定論的取值。
